selection: All 32 consecutively rendered rooms; feature examples selected from structural metadata.

display.color: Original tone-mapped sRGB, WebP quality 92. No exposure correction or crop.
display.depth: Grayscale linear depth / 15 m, clamped to [0,1]; 8-bit display preview.
display.position: World position normalized by annotation AABB, clamped to [0,1] for display.
display.semantic: Original semantic palette; lossless PNG-to-WebP RGB conversion.
display.plans: Manifest-derived plan and envelope section; solid-object footprint proxies; arrows are directions, not frusta. No implied visibility guarantee.
